title: Demo evidence suite runner
objective: 新增一个录屏 / 评审前可重复运行的一键证据套件：串联浏览器玩家链路截图、截图 report 校验、统一 demo evidence 导出，并写出 suite report，降低演示前手动命令遗漏风险。
acceptance_commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/tmp/demo_evidence_suite_acceptance')
report = json.loads((root / 'demo_evidence_suite_report.v0.1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert report['status'] == 'passed'
assert report['frontend_flow_visual_smoke']['status'] == 'captured'
assert report['frontend_flow_visual_smoke']['captured_screenshot_count'] == 14
assert report['frontend_flow_visual_smoke']['expected_screenshot_count'] == 14
assert report['demo_evidence']['export_validation_status'] == 'passed'
assert report['demo_evidence']['frontend_flow_status'] == 'captured'
assert report['safety_summary']['provider_call_count_during_suite'] == 0
assert report['safety_summary']['world_mutation_count_during_suite'] == 0
assert not report['failures']
for output in report['outputs'].values():
    assert output['exists'], output
PY
notes: 本任务只做本地演示证据编排，不调用 provider，不读取 .env，不生成新素材。
默认要求本地可用 Chromium 兼容浏览器；只有显式 --allow-missing-browser 才允许生成 browser_unavailable_allowed 套件报告。
suite report 只保存子命令摘要、输出文件指纹和安全计数，不保存原始 provider 响应、prompt 或 secret。
输出默认写入 /tmp，不把截图 PNG 或 evidence bundle 提交进仓库。
